info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/wan-25-preview/image-to-image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/wan-25-preview/image-to-image queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Edit images using WAN 2.5 image-to-image model.

WAN 2.5 image editing features:
- Subject-consistent image editing with text prompts
- Multi-image fusion (combine elements from multiple images)
- Image group generation
- Resolution: Width and height between 384 and 5000 pixels
- Up to 4 images per request
- Processing time: 1-2 minutes

num_images.title: Num Images
num_images.description: Number of images to generate. Values from 1 to 4.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
examples: low resolution, error, worst quality, low quality, defects
negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to describe content to avoid. Max 500 characters.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Width and height must be between 384 and 1440 pixels.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Reimagine the scene under a raging thunderstorm at night: lightning forks across the sky, illuminating the samurai in stark flashes of white light.
prompt.description: The text prompt describing how to edit the image. Max 2000 characters.

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: URLs of images to edit. For single-image editing, provide 1 URL. For multi-reference generation, provide up to 2 URLs. If more than 2 URLs are provided, only the first 2 will be used.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

actual_prompt.title: Actual Prompt
examples: Reimagine the scene under a raging thunderstorm at night: lightning forks across the sky, illuminating the samurai in stark flashes of white light.
actual_prompt.description: The original prompt (prompt expansion is not available for image editing)

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.description: The seeds used for each generated image

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
